content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Plumber Cum Mason: SSC Plus ITI (Plumbing) 02 Years full time course from government recognized institute / Two Years ITI Plus NCTVT in plumbing and civil maintenance. Required experience: Three years’ experience after ITI in plumbing and civil maintenance works in industry/Commercial-establishment/Hospitals.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCH Sangrur Plumber Cum Mason Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital Sangrur (HBCH Sangrur) for healthcare sector positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The position announced is Plumber Cum Mason under advertisement number OS/SNG/2026/28.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Plumber Cum Mason post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Plumber Cum Mason post on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Plumber Cum Mason?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed SSC Plus ITI (Plumbing) 02 Years full-time course with 3 years experience, or 2 Years ITI Plus NCTVT in plumbing and civil maintenance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 30 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government instructions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Plumber Cum Mason post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Plumber Cum Mason post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 20,650/- P.M.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application and selection process?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. The selection process includes an MCQ test in case of more candidates, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 08 December 2026 at the designated hospital venue in Sangrur.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Auditorium, 3rd Floor, New Building, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Sangrur, Punjab – 148001.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry a resume, 2 recent passport-size photographs, original documents, experience certificates, ID proofs, and photocopies of all required certificates.
